result.summary: Exposed the single-import lifecycle (WU-02/03/04/05/06) as seven internal Fastify routes under /internal/calendar/imports, with Idempotency-Key, caller-derived actor/source, distinguishable errors, real-DB progress, and no source secrets in responses.
result.report:
Implemented in apps/scheduling-service/src/modules/internal-api/routes.ts, one route per import operation, all guarded by requireInternalAuth + requireHumanCaller (AI never touches the import machinery, same policy as Goal009 blocks/exceptions):

- POST /internal/calendar/imports — registrar origem (ImportCompletionService.startSession), connection derived server-side via requireIntegration (never from body).
- POST /internal/calendar/imports/:sessionId/analyze — analisar (ImportPreviewService.analyze), reads the source through MinhaAgendaCalendarProvider built from the tenant's stored IntegrationConnection; response is a bounded summary (categories + change counts), not the full item array, to keep the Idempotency-Key snapshot small — items are read via the paginated route below.
- GET /internal/calendar/imports/:sessionId/categories/:category/items — listar itens/conflitos por categoria, paginated (limit/offset), optional status filter (status=NEEDS_REVIEW doubles as "list conflicts").
- POST /internal/calendar/imports/:sessionId/items/:itemId/decision — registrar decisão (new logic, since no prior WU implemented item-level decision application): EXCLUDE→SKIPPED, INCLUDE/CREATE_NEW→PENDING (ignoring the suggested match), MERGE_WITH_EXISTING/KEEP_EXISTING→IMPORTED against an existing Service/Customer plus an ExternalEntityMap upsert in the same transaction; a second decision on the same item (or one already resolved by execution) is rejected with IMPORT_ITEM_ALREADY_DECIDED. MERGE/KEEP_EXISTING require targetInternalId (422 IMPORT_DECISION_NOT_SUPPORTED_FOR_CATEGORY for categories with no matching, e.g. TIME_BLOCK; 404 IMPORT_DECISION_TARGET_NOT_FOUND for an unknown target).
- POST /internal/calendar/imports/:sessionId/execute — executar/retomar (ImportExecutionService.execute; resumption is the same route, since the engine is checkpoint-based by design).
- GET /internal/calendar/imports/:sessionId/progress — consultar progresso, tallied fresh from ImportItem rows on every call (never from the session's cached counters).
- POST /internal/calendar/imports/:sessionId/complete — concluir (ImportCompletionService.complete), passing the route's Idempotency-Key straight into the service's own idempotency option.

Idempotency-Key (reused idempotencyKey() header parser, same pattern as calendar/routes.ts) is required on every route with an effect (start, analyze, decision, execute, complete) and wrapped through CalendarMutationIdempotency (existing Goal008 infrastructure) via a small withImportIdempotency helper; GET routes (items, progress) carry none. source/actor are always context.userId/tenantId from currentInternalContext — every body schema simply has no source/userId/actor field, so zod's default "strip unknown keys" behavior discards a spoofed value; proven by tests that send a spoofed field and assert the persisted row (createdBy/decidedBy/completedBy) matches the header, not the body.

Distinguishable errors: IMPORT_SOURCE_RECORD_INVALID (existing, surfaces unmodified through /execute — out-of-contract source record), IMPORT_PREVIEW_STALE (existing), IMPORT_ALREADY_COMPLETED (existing), IMPORT_SESSION_LEASE_HELD (existing), IMPORT_ITEM_ALREADY_DECIDED (new, this WU). No route catches/rewrites AppError, so codes/status/details propagate to the existing Fastify error handler unchanged.

No secret leakage: item/decision DTOs only expose already-sanitized fields (label/reasonCode/reasonDetail, per WU-02/03/04 design); a dedicated test asserts the start-session response never contains the stored basicAuth/password.

Supporting changes: registerManagementRoutes(app, prismaClient = getPrisma()) gained an optional second parameter (pure DI, default unchanged, so production wiring in build-app.ts is untouched) to let tests inject the in-memory database double. tests/unit/support/database-double.ts gained an integrationConnection table (composite keys tenantId_id/tenantId_provider) — nothing else in that file was altered. New test-only file tests/unit/support/test-env.ts sets INTERNAL_SERVICE_TOKEN/INTEGRATION_CREDENTIALS_KEY before config/env.ts is first evaluated (ESM import-order technique), so the real internal-auth and credential-encryption code paths run unmocked in tests.

New test suite tests/unit/import-routes.test.ts (30 tests) builds a real Fastify app via app.inject() (no network, no real DB) covering: Idempotency-Key requirement and retry-returns-same-result (start, decision), source/actor derivation ignoring spoofed body fields (start, decision, complete), all five distinguishable errors reachable without hitting the network reader (session-state checks in the services run before any source read), pagination and status filtering for the items route, real-DB progress tallying against deliberately-stale session counters, merge-decision writing ExternalEntityMap, category-eligibility guard for merge decisions, tenant isolation, and no-secret-leak. IMPORT_SOURCE_RECORD_INVALID and the analyze/execute happy paths (which require a live network read) are intentionally not re-tested at the route level — they're already covered by the WU-02/03/04 service-level suites; the route's job (never catching/altering AppError) is proven identically by the other four error-code tests.

Commands run: `npx tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit` (0 errors), `npx eslint src --max-warnings=0` (0 errors — the 2 pre-existing errors in appointment-series-service.ts are untouched, outside this WU's scope, present at the baseline commit), `npx vitest run tests/unit/import-routes.test.ts` (30/30 passed), `npx vitest run --dir tests/unit` (238/238 passed, full suite).

acceptance.criterion: Existe uma rota por operação: registrar origem, analisar, listar itens/conflitos por categoria com paginação, registrar decisão, executar/retomar, consultar progresso e concluir
acceptance.detail: 7 routes under /internal/calendar/imports in routes.ts, one per operation (start, analyze, items-by-category with pagination, decision, execute/resume, progress, complete).

acceptance.criterion: Rotas com efeito aceitam Idempotency-Key e a retentativa devolve o mesmo resultado
acceptance.detail: idempotencyKey() required on start/analyze/decision/execute/complete via withImportIdempotency/CalendarMutationIdempotency or ImportCompletionService's own key; tests 'returns the same result on a retried Idempotency-Key' for start and decision assert identical body and no duplicate row.

acceptance.criterion: Erros próprios e distinguíveis existem para origem fora do contrato, preview obsoleto, importação já concluída, sessão já em execução e item já decidido
acceptance.detail: IMPORT_SOURCE_RECORD_INVALID (existing, passthrough), IMPORT_PREVIEW_STALE, IMPORT_ALREADY_COMPLETED, IMPORT_SESSION_LEASE_HELD, IMPORT_ITEM_ALREADY_DECIDED (new) — 4 of 5 covered by dedicated HTTP tests; the 5th is structurally identical passthrough.

acceptance.criterion: source e ator são derivados do chamador autenticado; um corpo que declara source ou ator divergente é ignorado, com teste que prova isso
acceptance.detail: Tests 'derives the actor from the caller, ignoring the body' (start, decision) and 'derives the completedBy actor from the caller' (complete) assert persisted rows match the header userId, not the spoofed body field.

acceptance.criterion: O progresso consultado reflete contagens reais do banco, não estimativa em memória
acceptance.detail: GET progress route tallies from a fresh ImportItem.findMany on every call; test seeds a session with default (zero) cached counters and asserts counts match the seeded items, not the session row.

acceptance.criterion: Nenhum segredo, credencial ou payload cru de origem aparece em resposta, log ou details
acceptance.detail: Test 'never leaks the stored credential' asserts the start-session response excludes basicAuth/password; item/decision DTOs only ever expose already-sanitized label/reasonCode/reasonDetail fields, never record.raw or credentialsEncrypted.
